shots.content: Fair-medium woman in orange pyjamas at a night mirror touching a brown patch on her cheek; smoky ghost 'Dullness' villain inside the mirror.
shots.note: L1 Dullness 'I control tonight's complexion.' plays off-screen over ANANYA studying realistic soft brown spots at the mirror at night (2.53 s). The woman is replaced, so all her shots (S1, S2, S6, S7) are replaced.

shots.content: Stern-eyed jar mascot on the vanity; the same fair woman leans in, clearly visible behind it.
shots.note: L2 jar 'Step away from the controls.' becomes the exact jar mascot talking (face on the lid, label clean) for 1.74 s.

shots.content: Macro of the open exact jar with a holographic '3XPERT FORMULA' HUD rising from the cream.
shots.note: Matches L3 'Activating my 3Xpert formula.' Big label text is correct. Check the small 'with Niacinamide & Alpha Arbutin' line at full resolution; if it is garbled, swap in KN01_hero_night.

shots.content: Jar mascot opens a briefcase holding three separate glowing hex badges: 2% KOJIC ACID, NIACINAMIDE, ALPHA ARBUTIN (spelled right, one style).
shots.note: This is exactly the client's 'three ingredients labelled separately'. It plays under L4 (Kojic) and L5 (Niacinamide).

shots.content: Small jar mascot with the briefcase fires a combined beam at the ghost in the mirror; our GLOW FUSION FORMULA claim on top.
shots.note: L6 'And alpha arbutin joins the brightening action.' No skin and no woman.

shots.content: The woman dabs a thick, unblended white blob on her freckled cheek.
shots.note: L7 'Now let the night shift begin.' plays over ANANYA applying at night and massaging until fully absorbed (2.7 s).

shots.content: The woman at the mirror talking to camera in warm light; dotted spots are still on her cheek under baked 'AFTER 2 WEEKS'.
shots.note: L8 woman 'Dark spots look reduced. My glow looks switched on.' now plays as VO with no lip-sync: first ANANYA waking in daylight with clear glowing skin (morning super), then the B/A split (KN08 | KN07, AFTER 2 WEEKS).

shots.content: Packshot: exact open jar on a marble pedestal with a glow arc; baked 'DERMDOC 2% KOJIC ACID NIGHT CREAM / GLOW FUSION FORMULA'.
shots.note: Jar is correct. The VO now says the full product name here.

script_changes.reason: The full product name is never said in this ad; the new line has the same syllable count (~10-11) over the packshot.

supers.why: The ghost is gone in KN03; place the tag by the mirror next to her dull cheek.
Client: the morning wake-up frame text must be 'brighter, clearer-looking skin by morning' style.
B/A split label under the left half.
Client: 'AFTER 2 WEEKS' under the after image (replaces the baked one on the old shot).

voice_changes.speaker: dullness
voice_changes.why: Deep growly male villain (~93 Hz); female VO only.

summary: Every woman shot is replaced (KN03 before, KNA1 jar talk, KN04 night application, KN06 morning wake plus B/A split). The 3XPERT HUD, briefcase hexes, beam and packshot are kept. The end line now says 'DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream' and the Dullness voice goes female.
